description: List the account's book of record, newest first: one immutable row per movement of value (payment_received, fee_prepaid, credit_purchase, refund_sent, fee_onchain, conversion, offramp_payout...) valued when it happened. Each record has `value` (market value at the block time in the reporting currency, rate and source included), `value_usd`, `contract_value` (what the customer owed at the invoice's locked rate), `tax`, the on-chain proof (tx_hash, block_height, addresses, explorer_url) and an invoice snapshot. `currency` re-values from value_usd at the historical rate. With a test key, rows created by simulate_test_payment appear only with include_simulated=true. Returns { object: 'list', data, has_more, next_cursor }.

asset.description: Records whose received, sent or fee leg is this asset.

currency.description: Re-value `value` into this currency (default: the account's reporting currency).

include_simulated.description: Test mode only: include rows created by simulate_test_payment, which the sandbox hides by default. Ignored with a live key.

occurred_gte.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; block time at or after.

occurred_lte.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; block time at or before.

name: list_records
title: List accounting records
